name: Partner Ecosystem Essentials
description: A minimal baseline practice for engaging with partner ecosystems, covering partner lifecycle management, value realization, capability building, trust cultivation, and governance.

focuses.name: Partner Value
focuses.description: Focuses on partner-driven business value, mutual benefits, and partnership ROI.

focuses.name: Partner Sales Execution
focuses.description: Governs partner relationship cultivation, trust building, and partnership governance.

focuses.name: Go-to-Market
focuses.description: Encapsulates partner capability development and joint market offerings.

narrativeTypes.name: Partner Ecosystem Journey
narrativeTypes.description: The journey organizations take as they build and mature their partner ecosystems, from initial partner discovery through sustained collaborative advantage.

narrativeElements.name: Discovery
narrativeElements.description: Organizations identify potential partners whose capabilities, values, and market presence complement strategic objectives.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Use this phase to emphasize finding the right partners rather than maximizing partner count. Focus activity on Partner Value (Identified, Qualified) and initial Partner Relationship states.

narrativeElements.name: Alignment
narrativeElements.description: Mutual value is established through transparent negotiations that balance benefits for all parties.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Use this phase to formalize partnership terms and build initial trust. Focus on Partner Value (Agreed) and Partner Trust (Initiated, Established) progression.

narrativeElements.name: Collaboration
narrativeElements.description: Partnerships deliver measurable outcomes as partners develop capabilities, co-create solutions, and navigate challenges together.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Use this phase to execute partnership activities and build operational cadence. Focus on Partner Relationship (Active), Partner Capability (Developing, Capable), and Partner Governance (Operating).

narrativeElements.name: Maturity
narrativeElements.description: Sustained partnerships generate compounding value as trust deepens, capabilities scale, and collaborative advantage (1+1>>2) becomes embedded in organizational culture.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Use this phase to optimize partnership value and sustain strategic commitment. Focus on Partner Value (Optimized), Partner Trust (Resilient), and Partner Capability (Scaling).

narrativeTypes.name: The STAR Format
narrativeTypes.description: Enforces a strict cause-and-effect relationship between context and outcomes (Situation, Task, Action, Result).

narrativeElements.name: Situation
narrativeElements.description: The context or background of the challenge.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Describe the specific situation, context, or baseline state before action is taken.

narrativeElements.name: Task
narrativeElements.description: The specific challenge, objective, or requirement.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Outline the specific task, problem, or goal that needs to be addressed.

narrativeElements.name: Action
narrativeElements.description: The specific steps or interventions performed.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Detail the methodology, activities, or steps taken to address the task.

narrativeElements.name: Result
narrativeElements.description: The outcome, impact, or value achieved.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Summarize the measurable results, outcomes, or state changes achieved from the actions.

narrativeTypes.name: The Hero's Journey
narrativeTypes.description: Highly effective for macro-level lifecycle orchestrations (platform adoptions, transformations).

narrativeElements.name: The Ordinary World
narrativeElements.description: The starting point before the transformation.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Describe the current, pre-platform state of the organization.

narrativeElements.name: The Call to Adventure
narrativeElements.description: The catalyst for change.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Outline the business opportunity, crisis, or driver that necessitates the platform transformation.

narrativeElements.name: The Ordeal
narrativeElements.description: The core transformation challenges and execution.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Detail the complex adoption activities, migrations, and challenges faced during implementation.

narrativeElements.name: The Return
narrativeElements.description: The new operational baseline and realized value.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Describe the successful adoption, the accrual of benefits, and the new optimized way of working.

narrativeTypes.name: The Three-Act Structure & StoryBrand
narrativeTypes.description: Positions the consumer as the Hero and the Platform Engineering team as the Guide utilizing the defined approach.

narrativeElements.name: Act I: The Hero and the Problem
narrativeElements.description: Identifying the consumer and their pain points.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Identify the primary consumer (the Hero) and detail the specific friction or problem they face.

narrativeElements.name: Act II: The Guide and the Plan
narrativeElements.description: The platform team offers a solution.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Introduce the Platform Engineering team as the Guide who provides a clear, paved-path approach or plan.

narrativeElements.name: Act III: Call to Action and Success
narrativeElements.description: Execution and outcome.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Describe the call to action for the consumer to adopt the plan, and the successful outcome of doing so.

narrativeTypes.name: Micro-Narratives (ABT)
narrativeTypes.description: Shorter frameworks (And/But/Therefore) designed for rapid, highly persuasive daily execution updates.

narrativeElements.name: And (Context)
narrativeElements.description: The current situation and baseline facts.
narrativeElements.howToUse: State the current agreed-upon context, background, and baseline facts.

narrativeElements.name: But (Conflict)
narrativeElements.description: The problem, challenge, or contradiction.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Introduce the specific problem, blocker, challenge, or contradiction encountered.

narrativeElements.name: Therefore (Resolution)
narrativeElements.description: The action taken or conclusion reached.
narrativeElements.howToUse: State the specific action taken, decision made, or conclusion reached to resolve the conflict.

narrativeTypes.name: Lifecycle
narrativeTypes.description: A standard lifecycle orchestration framework to map progression phases.

narrativeElements.name: Prerequisites
narrativeElements.description: Conditions required before starting the lifecycle.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Define the Phase 0 or preparation steps, including baseline checks or prerequisite states, that must be achieved before the main lifecycle begins.

narrativeElements.name: Lifecycle Phase
narrativeElements.description: An active stage of lifecycle execution.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Detail the active state transitions, required work products, and activities for this specific phase of the lifecycle progression.

narrativeTypes.name: Essay Narrative
narrativeTypes.description: A cohesive narrative format that guides the reader carefully through the evidence for and against a proposition before reaching a conclusion.

narrativeElements.name: Introduction
narrativeElements.description: The start of the essay used to contextualise the work and grab the attention of the reader.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Explain how the topic sits within the framework of the subject area as a whole. Outline the structure of your essay very briefly, but do not give your conclusions away on the first page.

narrativeElements.name: Defining Key Concepts
narrativeElements.description: A section establishing the interpretation of central concepts without relying on dictionary definitions.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Relate in your own words how the terms you will be using are to be interpreted within the context of your essay.

narrativeElements.name: Presenting Evidence
narrativeElements.description: The core discussion where secondary works are evaluated and viewpoints are balanced against each other.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Be selective in your choice of evidence and use signposting language to guide your reader. Quote sparingly, paraphrase occasionally, and summarise often to integrate other people's ideas into your own argument.

narrativeElements.name: Conclusion
narrativeElements.description: The closing section that synthesises the presented evidence and forms a direct response to the assignment title.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Draw the threads of your argument together. Do not bring in new evidence in your concluding paragraphs or try to cram in ideas that you have not developed fully.

narrativeTypes.name: Report Narrative
narrativeTypes.description: A formal, informative structure broken down into sections and sub-sections to order and communicate relevant information in an easily navigable way.

narrativeElements.name: Executive Summary
narrativeElements.description: A stand-alone summary of the entire report's purpose, methodology, findings, conclusions, and recommendations.
narrativeElements.howToUse: This should be the last thing that you write. Keep it concise (usually a paragraph or two and always less than a page) to enable the reader to make an informed decision about whether they want to read the report itself.

narrativeElements.name: Introduction
narrativeElements.description: Explains the rationale for undertaking the work reported on, the background, and the scope of the report.
narrativeElements.howToUse: State what the report is about, define how it meets the requirements of the brief, and explain your research methods.

narrativeElements.name: Methods
narrativeElements.description: A clear description of how the investigation was carried out and why specific methods were chosen.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Write this section concisely but thoroughly. Provide step-by-step details in such a way that a reader could replicate the research you have done.

narrativeElements.name: Results and Findings
narrativeElements.description: A purely factual presentation of the research data using text, graphs, tables, or diagrams.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Present the findings of your research as simply as possible. Save your interpretation of the results for the Discussion section.

narrativeElements.name: Discussion
narrativeElements.description: The section that brings everything together by showing how the findings relate to the purpose of the report and previous research.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Interpret the results, showing how they respond to the brief explained in the introduction. Mention if there were any problems or unexpected results and how they were solved.

narrativeElements.name: Recommendations
narrativeElements.description: Suggestions for a future course of action based on the evidence and conclusions.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Make recommendations that solve problems or help to develop a new strategy. Make an effort to sound authoritative and certain in your choices.

narrativeTypes.name: PDCA
narrativeTypes.description: Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle (Deming Cycle) for continuous improvement and iterative refinement.

narrativeElements.name: Plan
narrativeElements.description: Establish objectives and processes.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Identify improvement opportunity, analyze current state, and plan intervention.

narrativeElements.name: Do
narrativeElements.description: Implement the plan on small scale.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Execute the planned change or experiment in controlled environment.

narrativeElements.name: Check
narrativeElements.description: Measure and evaluate results.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Assess outcomes against objectives, identify gaps and learnings.

narrativeElements.name: Act
narrativeElements.description: Standardize or iterate based on learnings.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Scale successful changes, adjust plan based on findings, repeat cycle.

narrativeTypes.name: Build-Measure-Learn
narrativeTypes.description: Lean Startup cycle for validating assumptions through rapid experimentation and feedback.

narrativeElements.name: Build
narrativeElements.description: Create minimum viable solution.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Develop smallest increment that can test key hypothesis or assumption.

narrativeElements.name: Measure
narrativeElements.description: Collect data and feedback.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Instrument, observe, and gather quantitative and qualitative evidence.

narrativeElements.name: Learn
narrativeElements.description: Analyze and decide next iteration.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Synthesize findings, validate or invalidate hypothesis, pivot or persevere.

narrativeTypes.name: Design-Build-Run-Optimize
narrativeTypes.description: Architectural lifecycle for infrastructure and platform engineering spanning conception through continuous improvement.

narrativeElements.name: Design
narrativeElements.description: Architecture definition and planning.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Define architecture, topology, technology choices, and capacity planning.

narrativeElements.name: Build
narrativeElements.description: Provisioning and configuration.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Deploy infrastructure, configure systems, establish integrations and connectivity.

narrativeElements.name: Run
narrativeElements.description: Operations and steady-state management.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Monitor health, respond to incidents, maintain availability and performance.

narrativeElements.name: Optimize
narrativeElements.description: Continuous improvement and evolution.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Tune performance, reduce costs, enhance capabilities based on operational insights.

narrativeTypes.name: Crawl-Walk-Run
narrativeTypes.description: Maturity progression model for incremental capability building and adoption.

narrativeElements.name: Crawl
narrativeElements.description: Initial capability establishment.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Establish foundational capability with limited scope, manual processes, learning focus.

narrativeElements.name: Walk
narrativeElements.description: Capability refinement and scaling.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Expand scope, introduce automation, standardize processes, build confidence.

narrativeElements.name: Run
narrativeElements.description: Mature, optimized operation.
narrativeElements.howToUse: Full automation, enterprise scale, optimization focus, continuous evolution.

narratives.name: Partner Ecosystem Baseline Story
narratives.description: The narrative arc for organizations building partner ecosystems using this baseline practice.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations begin by identifying potential partners (Partner Value: Identified) and making initial contact (Partner Relationship: Initiated). Activity spaces 'Identify and Qualify Partners' and 'Manage Partner Relationships' are most active.

Partnerships formalize as value expectations are qualified and agreed (Partner Value: Qualified, Agreed). Trust building begins (Partner Trust: Initiated, Established) through transparent negotiations. 'Measure Partner Value' and 'Build and Maintain Trust' activity spaces guide this phase.

Active partnerships deliver value (Partner Relationship: Active) as capabilities develop (Partner Capability: Developing, Capable) under established governance (Partner Governance: Operating). All activity spaces are engaged to sustain operational cadence.

Strategic partnerships optimize value realization (Partner Value: Optimized), demonstrate resilient trust (Partner Trust: Resilient), and scale capabilities (Partner Capability: Scaling). The partnership becomes self-sustaining and generates collaborative advantage exceeding individual contributions.

alphas.name: Partner Value
alphas.description: The mutual benefits, business outcomes, and measurable returns that justify and sustain partner ecosystem investment.

states.name: Identified
states.description: Potential partner-driven business value is recognized in a market segment, technology domain, or customer relationship.

checklist.name: Business opportunity scoped
checklist.description: The specific business opportunity or strategic objective is clearly defined.

checklist.name: Partner role articulated
checklist.description: How partners would contribute capabilities or reach is understood.

states.name: Qualified
states.description: Partner-driven value is assessed against strategic fit criteria, and mutual benefits are quantified.

checklist.name: Strategic fit validated
checklist.description: Partnership aligns with organizational strategy and ideal partner profile.

checklist.name: Mutual benefits identified
checklist.description: Value for both parties is explicitly articulated.

checklist.name: Investment justified
checklist.description: Partnership investment is justified against alternative approaches (build, buy).

states.name: Agreed
states.description: Value expectations, revenue models, and benefit-sharing structures are formalized and committed.

checklist.name: Value expectations documented
checklist.description: Expected outcomes and success metrics are formally documented.

checklist.name: Economic model agreed
checklist.description: Revenue sharing, incentives, or cost models are agreed by all parties.

checklist.name: Commitments formalized
checklist.description: Mutual commitments are captured in agreements or memoranda.

states.name: Delivered
states.description: Partnership is producing measurable business outcomes and tangible benefits for all parties.

checklist.name: Outcomes being realized
checklist.description: Partnership is delivering against agreed success metrics.

checklist.name: Benefits flowing to all parties
checklist.description: All partners are receiving net benefits exceeding their investment.

checklist.name: Performance tracked
checklist.description: Regular measurement and reporting of partnership outcomes is established.

states.name: Optimized
states.description: Partnership value is continuously improved through data-driven insights and evolving value models.

checklist.name: Performance data drives decisions
checklist.description: Partnership adjustments are based on performance data and insights.

checklist.name: Value models evolve
checklist.description: Economic and benefit models adapt to market dynamics and partner feedback.

checklist.name: Collaborative advantage realized
checklist.description: Partnership delivers more than the sum of individual contributions (1+1>>2).

alphas.name: Partner Relationship
alphas.description: The structured engagement and collaboration between the organization and its partner organizations, from initial contact through strategic alliance.

states.name: Initiated
states.description: Initial contact is established with a potential partner organization.

checklist.name: Partner identified
checklist.description: Potential partner organization is identified and initial contact made.

checklist.name: Mutual interest confirmed
checklist.description: Both parties express interest in exploring partnership.

states.name: Established
states.description: Partnership terms are agreed, initial trust is built, and collaboration framework is defined.

checklist.name: Expectations aligned
checklist.description: Both parties have shared understanding of partnership scope and expectations.

checklist.name: Agreements in place
checklist.description: Necessary agreements, contracts, or MOUs are executed.

checklist.name: Initial trust demonstrated
checklist.description: Partners have demonstrated reliability through initial interactions.

states.name: Active
states.description: Partnership is operationally delivering with regular cadence of activities and communication.

checklist.name: Regular engagement rhythm
checklist.description: Partners engage in regular touchpoints, meetings, and collaborative activities.

checklist.name: Deliverables flowing
checklist.description: Partnership is producing tangible outputs and progressing toward objectives.

checklist.name: Issues addressed constructively
checklist.description: Partners handle challenges and conflicts constructively.

states.name: Strategic
states.description: Partnership achieves strategic importance with deep collaboration and executive alignment.

checklist.name: Executive sponsorship
checklist.description: Senior leadership from both organizations actively sponsor the partnership.

checklist.name: Deep integration
checklist.description: Partnership involves significant operational integration and resource commitment.

checklist.name: Strategic planning aligned
checklist.description: Organizations collaborate on strategic planning and roadmap alignment.

states.name: Renewing
states.description: Partnership value is sustained through ongoing investment, evolution, or graceful transition.

checklist.name: Renewal decision made
checklist.description: Explicit decision to continue, evolve, or conclude partnership is reached.

checklist.name: Sustained commitment
checklist.description: Both parties continue to invest resources and leadership attention.

checklist.name: Evolution path clear
checklist.description: Future direction for partnership (deepening, pivoting, or concluding) is understood.

alphas.name: Partner Capability
alphas.description: The skills, expertise, and delivery competencies that partners develop to contribute value within the ecosystem.

states.name: Assessed
states.description: Partner's current capabilities and skill gaps are identified relative to partnership needs.

checklist.name: Current capabilities understood
checklist.description: Partner's existing skills, expertise, and capacity are documented.

checklist.name: Gaps identified
checklist.description: Capability gaps relative to partnership requirements are identified.

states.name: Developing
states.description: Partner is actively building capabilities through training, enablement, or joint delivery.

checklist.name: Development plan active
checklist.description: Partner is following a structured capability development plan.

checklist.name: Resources engaged
checklist.description: Partner has dedicated resources to capability building.

checklist.name: Progress tracked
checklist.description: Capability development progress is monitored and reported.

states.name: Capable
states.description: Partner has validated capabilities to independently deliver partnership value.

checklist.name: Capabilities validated
checklist.description: Partner has demonstrated proficiency in required skills and expertise.

checklist.name: Independent delivery proven
checklist.description: Partner can deliver without close supervision or intervention.

checklist.name: Quality standards met
checklist.description: Partner deliverables consistently meet quality expectations.

states.name: Scaling
states.description: Partner is expanding capability across their organization and contributing to ecosystem knowledge.

checklist.name: Internal scaling
checklist.description: Partner is growing their team and replicating capabilities internally.

checklist.name: Knowledge contributed
checklist.description: Partner contributes expertise back to the ecosystem (documentation, training, tools).

checklist.name: Peer enablement
checklist.description: Partner helps enable other ecosystem participants.

alphas.name: Partner Governance
alphas.description: The policies, structures, and operational controls that ensure partnership accountability and effective decision-making.

states.name: Defined
states.description: Partnership governance structures, policies, and decision-making processes are established.

checklist.name: Governance structure documented
checklist.description: Roles, responsibilities, and decision-making authority are clearly defined.

checklist.name: Policies established
checklist.description: Key policies (conflict resolution, escalation, risk management) are documented.

checklist.name: Communication channels defined
checklist.description: Regular communication and review cadences are established.

states.name: Operating
states.description: Governance structures are actively functioning and partnership is managed through established processes.

checklist.name: Regular reviews occurring
checklist.description: Scheduled governance reviews and business reviews are happening consistently.

checklist.name: Decisions documented
checklist.description: Partnership decisions are captured and tracked.

checklist.name: Escalations handled
checklist.description: Issues requiring escalation follow defined processes and are resolved.

states.name: Optimized
states.description: Governance practices continuously improve based on partnership feedback and performance data.

checklist.name: Data-driven governance
checklist.description: Governance decisions are informed by partnership performance data and insights.

checklist.name: Processes evolve
checklist.description: Governance structures adapt based on partnership maturity and feedback.

checklist.name: Efficiency improved
checklist.description: Governance overhead is minimized while maintaining accountability.

alphas.name: Partner Trust
alphas.description: The psychological safety, reliability, and mutual confidence that underpins effective partner collaboration.

states.name: Initiated
states.description: Initial trust-building activities begin as partners demonstrate reliability and transparency.

checklist.name: Openness established
checklist.description: Partners communicate openly and transparently in initial interactions.

checklist.name: Commitments honored
checklist.description: Partners consistently deliver on small commitments.

states.name: Established
states.description: Trust is validated through demonstrated reliability, shared vulnerability, and mutual benefit.

checklist.name: Track record built
checklist.description: Partners have history of fulfilling commitments and acting reliably.

checklist.name: Transparency practiced
checklist.description: Partners share information openly including challenges and constraints.

checklist.name: Mutual benefit evident
checklist.description: Both parties experience tangible benefits from the partnership.

states.name: Sustained
states.description: Trust deepens through navigating challenges together and consistent demonstration of shared values.

checklist.name: Challenges navigated together
checklist.description: Partners have successfully worked through conflicts or difficulties collaboratively.

checklist.name: Values alignment demonstrated
checklist.description: Partners exhibit compatible values and ethical standards in practice.

checklist.name: Psychological safety present
checklist.description: Partners feel safe raising concerns and having difficult conversations.

states.name: Resilient
states.description: Trust has proven durable through significant challenges and becomes self-reinforcing foundation for innovation.

checklist.name: Trust tested and strengthened
checklist.description: Partnership has weathered significant challenges without trust erosion.

checklist.name: Innovation enabled
checklist.description: High trust enables risk-taking and collaborative innovation.

checklist.name: Cultural integration
checklist.description: Trust is embedded in how organizations work together, not dependent on individuals.

activitySpaces.name: Identify and Qualify Partners
activitySpaces.description: Discover potential partners, assess strategic fit, and validate mutual value opportunities.

activitySpaces.name: Manage Partner Relationships
activitySpaces.description: Cultivate and sustain partner relationships through regular engagement, communication, and collaborative problem-solving.

activitySpaces.name: Build Partner Capabilities
activitySpaces.description: Enable partners to develop skills, expertise, and delivery capabilities needed for successful collaboration.

activitySpaces.name: Govern Partner Ecosystem
activitySpaces.description: Establish and maintain governance structures, policies, and accountability mechanisms for partnerships.

activitySpaces.name: Measure Partner Value
activitySpaces.description: Track partnership performance, quantify outcomes, and optimize value realization for all parties.

activitySpaces.name: Build and Maintain Trust
activitySpaces.description: Cultivate trust through transparency, reliability, shared values, and collaborative challenge resolution.

competencies.name: Partner Relationship Management
competencies.description: The ability to build, nurture, and manage effective relationships with partner organizations across the partnership lifecycle.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands partner communication channels and basic engagement protocols.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can execute structured partner engagement activities and conduct routine touchpoints.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently manage partner portfolios and navigate complex relationship dynamics.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can build executive-level relationships and resolve conflicts while preserving partnerships.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Creates transformative relationship models that become partnership excellence standards.

competencies.name: Partner Strategic Alignment
competencies.description: The ability to align partner ecosystem initiatives with business objectives, market opportunities, and strategic priorities.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands the purpose of partner ecosystems and how partnerships create value.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can articulate how specific partners contribute to organizational strategy.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently develop partner strategies and ideal partner profiles aligned with business goals.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can pivot partnership strategy in response to market dynamics and competitive pressures.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Pioneers new partnership models and ecosystem strategies that redefine industry norms.

competencies.name: Partner Governance
competencies.description: The ability to design, implement, and optimize partnership governance structures and accountability mechanisms.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands partnership governance fundamentals and basic policies.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can execute governance processes and facilitate partnership reviews.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently design governance frameworks appropriate to partnership complexity.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can balance governance rigor with partnership flexibility across diverse partner types.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Develops transformative governance approaches that maximize partnership value while ensuring accountability.

competencies.name: Partner Trust Building
competencies.description: The ability to establish, maintain, and repair trust across partner relationships through transparency, reliability, and shared values.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands trust fundamentals and the role of transparency and reliability.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can demonstrate trustworthy behaviors and build trust through consistent actions.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can design trust-building approaches and facilitate trust development across partnerships.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can repair damaged trust and navigate complex trust dynamics in multi-party partnerships.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Creates trust-based partnership cultures that enable breakthrough collaboration and innovation.

competencies.name: Partner Value Assessment
competencies.description: The ability to assess partnership value, quantify outcomes, and optimize mutual benefit realization using data-driven methods.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can understand basic partnership metrics and value concepts.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can analyze partnership performance against targets and identify trends.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently design value frameworks and translate data into actionable strategies.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can build predictive models for partnership ROI and optimize ecosystem value.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Develops novel value assessment frameworks that redefine partnership economics.
